# Pull Request Template

When creating pull requests, always use this format for the PR body:

## Overview

Provide the summary pull request overview
EXAMPLE: Closes #71. Adding library or custom component source-code

## What & why

Provide the explanation about what, and why this change must do. Plus if there is trade-off because this feature or change then elaborate here.

## Documented Flow or Planning

Provide the documented flow before and after the change if necessary, and please provide with flowchart diagram using mermaid.js format

## Reference Issue tag

Provide the issue that has been worked on in these changes

## Changelog

Provide the list of commits/issues worked on in these changes

## Deployment Notes

Provide special event action when deployed to dev and prod environment (optional)

The deployment step will be added and documented here Deployment Step..
